CODING WORKSPACEOriginal practice problem

Two trades, one target

Easy

Given an array of integers values and an integer target, return the indices of two distinct elements whose sum equals the target.

Exactly one valid pair exists. You may return the indices in either order, but you cannot use the same element twice.

EXAMPLEvalues = [2, 7, 11, 15], target = 9
Output: [0, 1]

values[0] + values[1] = 2 + 7 = 9

Constraints & expectations
  • 2 ≤ values.length ≤ 10,000
  • −10⁹ ≤ values[i], target ≤ 10⁹
  • Exactly one valid solution; repeated values are allowed.
  • Start by explaining your approach. Aim for O(n) time.
